issue.title: Task-list child lines open no &/*/~/@ picker and capture-parse reports no needs, though bob capture accepts the modifier

task_type_fields.impact: Bob Mac Capture and any `capture-complete` client: typing `&`, `*`, `~`, or `@` on a note or requirement under a task-list bullet opens no picker, and `capture-parse` gives no `needs` entry to drive one. The user must type the complete `&note:block-id` by hand. Pre-existing: free-level list child lines behave the same on the pre-landing baseline, so this is not caused by epic bob-cli-on.6.1.
task_type_fields.location: src/native/capture_language/completion.rs completion_field_at_with child-line branch (has_previous_first_level_authored_item); tokens.rs parent_task_selector_tokens; capture-parse needs for list items
task_type_fields.repro:
In a vault with `work.md` holding `- [ ] #task Other work ^wo` (on master 2f4fef6d and with the bob-cli-on.6.1 landing applied):

1. `bob capture-complete -f json -c <end> -- $'@work\n- task one\n  - note &wo'` returns `"context": null` with no candidates. The same is true for `*wo`, `~wo`, and `@wo` on the list item's child line, and for a requirement child (`  - [ ] r1 &wo`). The list bullet's own line (`- task one &wo`) does open `task_dependency`.
2. `bob capture-parse -f json -- $'@work\n- task one\n  - note &wo'` emits an `interactive_placeholder` span for `&wo` but reports `"needs": []`.
3. `bob capture --dry-run -f json -- $'@work\n- task one\n  - note &wo'` refuses with "prerequisite selection is incomplete: finish typing the `&note:block-id` modifier". The completed form `  - note &work:wo` is accepted and writes `[dependsOn:: work__wo]`.

So the child-line modifier is valid in execution, but the editor gets no picker and no `needs` entry. The Mac editor cannot complete it.

Likely root cause (completion half): `completion.rs::completion_field_at_with`'s child-line branch drops any nested line with no earlier first-level authored line (`has_previous_first_level_authored_item`). A task-list item's child lines all sit at raw level 2 (the bullet itself is the item line), so every one of them reads as an orphan. `tokens.rs::parent_task_selector_tokens` has the same orphan guard. The `needs` half (placeholder without a need) is unexamined.

issue.creation_reason: Found by the bob-cli-on.6.1 land agent while checking depth parity: list-item child lines are a pre-existing completion gap that the requirement-chain work did not cause, so it needs its own fix.
